name: Cream of Cucumber Soup
description: A refreshing and creamy cucumber soup made with chicken broth, milk, and a hint of cayenne pepper.

recipeInstructions.text: In the microwave, cook onions and olive oil on High for 2 minutes.
Dice cucumbers and add to onions. Cook until soft.
Use a blender to purée the cucumbers (hand blender works well).
Mix the flour with ¼ cup chicken broth. Add to the cucumbers, along with the remaining chicken broth, cayenne, and nutmeg. Cook 6 to 8 minutes on High.
Add the milk and dill. Serve.

keywords: cucumber soup, creamy soup, refreshing soup

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

_similar.name: Cream of Asparagus Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and smooth asparagus soup made with canned asparagus, perfect for serving year-round with optional fresh garnishes.
recipeIngredient: 2 (12 oz) cans asparagus tips or cuttings

recipeInstructions.text: Chop onions and celery medium fine and sauté in butter until limp but not brown.
Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken stock (dissolve bouillon cubes in water) and stir until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then add canned asparagus including liquid and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Purée the soup in a blender and press through a sieve for a smooth texture.
To serve, bring soup to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in whipping cream.
Season to taste and keep warm over low heat without boiling.

_similar.keywords: asparagus soup, creamy soup, canned asparagus

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.
Puree the mixture until smooth.
Heat with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup
